name: iPhone 12 Pro

bottom.datum: 0.00 at left of bottom view; view drawn with display up and camera bump down, so 0.00 is the phone's left edge as seen from the front

notes: Dimension numbers on this drawing are vector outlines, not PDF text: pg.get_text('words') returns only the title/footer, so the verbatim text check cannot confirm any value; every number was read visually from crops at 3.5x-12x zoom and cross-checked by symmetry about the centre ordinate and by an independent tesseract OCR pass over the rendered sheet (which found all but a handful of the values; those were re-read at higher zoom). centreLine values are measured across the thickness (about half of it); which face they are taken from was not determined. Ring/silent switch values are for its POCKET (25.99 and 3.69 'POCKET CENTER', 2X 2.85, 2.12 pocket width). SIM tray: width 2.66 and a 1.33 tray-edge-to-centre dimension, but no centre-line distance from a face, so centreLine is null. Plateau = outermost camera outline; inner outline also dimensioned at x 4.62-32.94, y 4.62-35.11. Plateau corner radius not dimensioned. LiDAR scanner is not drawn or dimensioned in Detail D (it sits inside the plateau). Connector width not dimensioned (height 3.01; keepout 13.65 x 6.85; ordinates 31.38 and 40.14 straddle the 35.76 centre). Bottom ordinates: 19.18 25.14 29.37 31.38 40.14 42.16 46.38 56.85. Button protrusion: switch 0.60, volume 0.45, side 0.45.
